title: The Stewardship Contract Layer: testing STRUCTURE instead of SELECTION on the recovered N=992 (pre-registered and hash-locked BEFORE any gate was computed)
the_diagnosis_this_design_responds_to: Every banking trial so far tested the same thing and failed at it: SELECTION. Can a fidelity signal pick better borrowers than prestige can? The answer, across four pre-registered runs, is no. N=27 gave 2/4, N=44 gave 1/4 with the portfolio advantage collapsing to an exact tie, the flat floor on N=992 gave 3/5 and anti-selected, and the stratified relative floor gave 2/5 while defaulting at roughly eighteen times the naive capacity baseline. The mechanism is now known and is not a threshold problem: within a capacity tier the sign of the fidelity-outcome relationship is INVERTED (weighted AUC 0.3397), so every admission rule that prefers high D selects for failure. Selection on D is finished. This pre-registration therefore stops testing selection.
what_is_actually_being_tested_now: Whether CONTRACT STRUCTURE changes outcomes when SELECTION IS HELD FIXED. The governance reading of stewardship (khilafah as a delegated-capacity role, mudarabah as delegated capacity with shared outcome, musharakah as proportional co-ownership) is not a claim about who to admit. It is a claim about how delegated capacity is structured, monitored and unwound. That claim has never been tested here, and it is orthogonal to everything that failed. Selection is conceded entirely and in writing: SC1 asserts that both books contain THE SAME borrowers with THE SAME real defaults, so no selection advantage can be smuggled in.
the_immunisation_hazard_again: Moving from selection to structure could easily be another retreat that makes the framework unfalsifiable -- 'we never claimed to pick winners' after failing to pick winners. Three protections are written in. First, selection is conceded explicitly and mechanically (SC1), not argued away. Second, the design's PRINCIPAL COST is itself a pre-registered gate: SC4 predicts the risk-sharing institution ends with LESS capital than the debt institution, so the trade-off is measured, not hidden. Third, SC7 gives the discredited signal one narrow, falsifiable second chance in a genuinely different role, with a real cost attached, and it is allowed to fail.

data.cohort: data/github/govphys_quadratic_results.csv -- the recovered N=992 cohort (prereg cac34f44), verified by recomputation from its rows (7/7). Committed.
data.outcome: default = (E == 0). The REAL default sequence is used unchanged. No borrower is selected, excluded, reweighted or reordered by any fidelity quantity.
data.declared_substrate_limitation: IMPORTANT. GitHub repositories are a poor analogue for credit borrowers: a repository has no balance sheet, no collateral, no obligation to repay, and its 'default' costs no counterparty anything. Its abandonment is driven largely by whether anyone is funded to maintain it, which is why capacity predicts it so strongly (top star quintile defaults at 2.5% against a 75.6% base rate). This substrate is used because it is the only real, committed, non-circular outcome cohort available at N=992 -- not because it resembles a loan book. Every result here is a statement about contract mechanics over a real failure sequence, NOT a claim about credit markets.

contract_parameters_fixed_before_running.note: All values are round, conventional and chosen before any gate was computed. None may be adjusted after seeing a result.

the_two_structures.debt: The institution advances capital with a priority claim of principal * (1 + r). On success it collects that claim in full regardless of how well the project did. On default it collects the recovery phi and the borrower bears the residual shortfall as well as losing their own stake -- loss is pushed downward and the lender's yield is insulated from the borrower's outcome.
the_two_structures.equity: Mudarabah/musharakah structure. The institution holds a 90% proportional share and the borrower 10%. On success the surplus is shared in proportion. On default the loss is shared in the same proportion and there is NO RECOURSE -- the borrower's liability ends at their stake. Full reserve: the institution can never issue claims exceeding deposits received.

gates.SC1_selection_is_conceded_mechanically: Both books must contain exactly the same N borrowers with exactly the same number of real defaults. DECLARED falsifiable:false -- it is enforced by construction. It is an HONESTY gate, present so that no structural result can be mistaken for a recovered selection advantage, and it is excluded from the score.
gates.SC2_borrower_loss_dispersion_is_lower_un: Risk-sharing should compress the distribution of borrower outcomes, not just its mean. Compare the standard deviation of borrower net outcome across all contracts. PASS iff the equity structure's dispersion is strictly lower. CAN FAIL.
gates.SC3_worst_case_borrower_loss_is_bounded: Under equity the borrower's liability must never exceed their stake (no recourse). Compare the worst single borrower outcome in each structure. PASS iff equity's worst case is strictly better. DECLARED close to construction-favoured (no-recourse is definitional) and reported as SUPPORTING only.
gates.SC4_risk_sharing_costs_the_institution_c: THE HONEST COST, PRE-REGISTERED AS A PREDICTION. Absorbing losses that debt would have pushed onto borrowers must show up as lower terminal capital for the institution. PASS iff the equity institution's terminal capital is strictly LOWER than the debt institution's. FALSIFIABLE: if equity somehow preserves more capital on a real 75.6%-default sequence, the stated trade-off is wrong and must be corrected. A pass here is not a win for the design -- it is the design's price, measured.
gates.SC5_can_a_risk_sharing_institution_even_: SOLVENCY. Starting from capital equal to the total deployed, does the equity institution end with capital above zero on the real default sequence? PASS iff terminal capital > 0. CAN FAIL, and is expected to be at genuine risk given a 75.6% base default rate. A failure is a real and important finding: it would mean pure risk-sharing is not viable over a population this failure-dense, and that the viability of the structure depends on the population, not on the contract.
gates.SC6_full_reserve_bounds_systemic_shortfa: Scan leverage multipliers for the DEBT institution and record the multiplier at which depositor claims exceed recoverable assets on the real default sequence. Report the depositor shortfall at each multiplier. The full-reserve equity institution issues no claim exceeding deposits, so depositor shortfall is identically zero. DECLARED falsifiable:false for the zero-shortfall half -- it is definitional -- and the LEVERAGE THRESHOLD is reported as a measured quantity, not as a passed test. Excluded from the score.
gates.SC7_tau_v_as_a_covenant_trigger_rather_t: THE SIGNAL'S SECOND AND LAST CHANCE, IN A DIFFERENT ROLE. Enforcement latency failed as a SCREEN because capacity dominates admission. Monitoring is a different problem: once capital is already deployed, any signal with genuine discrimination can pay for itself by triggering early exit. Rule: exit any contract whose tau_v exceeds 60 days, recovering the institution's stake less a 30% haircut. PASS iff the covenant book's terminal capital strictly exceeds the hold-everything baseline. FALSIFIABLE AND AT REAL RISK: the 30% exit cost is charged on every trigger including false positives, so a weakly discriminating signal loses money. If this fails, tau_v has no demonstrated economic use in this design and must be retired from the financial layer entirely.

symmetric_null: Every dispersion, capital balance, threshold and shortfall is reported with its exact value whether or not it favours the design. SC2, SC4, SC5 and SC7 are genuinely at risk. SC1, SC3 and SC6 are declared construction-favoured or definitional and are reported at reduced weight or excluded from the score, because a check that cannot fail is not evidence. No parameter or threshold in this file may move after the lock.
what_a_pass_would_and_would_not_mean: Passing SC2, SC5 and SC7 would establish that on one real failure sequence, proportional risk-sharing compresses borrower outcomes, remains solvent, and that enforcement latency has economic value as a monitoring trigger even though it failed as an admission screen. It would NOT establish that such an institution is competitive, profitable, scalable, legally implementable, or that any of this transfers from software repositories to human borrowers -- see the declared substrate limitation. It would NOT validate any theological or normative claim; the OQM terminology here is a Layer-2 operational vocabulary, and no Layer-1 result adjudicates a Layer-3 prior.
acceptance: GREEN when this spec re-hashes to its published canonical SHA-256, the cohort re-hashes to the sha256 recorded by the recovery verification, and every gate is evaluated exactly as written -- with misses recorded, asserted in tests, and carried into the README. Exit 0 means 'reproduces including its failures', never 'the design is validated'.
